# Score cells for receptor expression

```{r, include=FALSE}
sc_combined_receptors_score <- AddModuleScore_UCell(sc_combined, features = list(common_receptors), name = "sc_combined_receptors_score")

means_sc_combined_receptors_score <- sc_combined_receptors_score@meta.data %>%
  group_by(seurat_clusters) %>%
  summarise(average_sc_combined_receptors_score = mean(signature_1sc_combined_receptors_score, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
print(means_sc_combined_receptors_score)
```

```{r}
cluster_colours <- c(
    "Satellite cells"      = "#FF7FBF",
    "Myoblasts"            = "#FF3F80",
    "Myonuclei"            = "#E00000",
    "Endothelial cells"    = "#FFFF00",
    "vSMCs"                = "#BC9D00",
    "Pericytes"            = "#8B5A2B",
    "FAPs"                 = "#7CFC00",
    "Tenocytes"            = "#228B22",
    "Platelets"            = "#D46A6A", 
    "Mast cells"           = "#C85C8C", 
    "Dendritic cells"      = "#B84D9E", 
    "Monocytes"            = "#80E5FF",
    "Macrophages"          = "#1E90FF",
    "Neutrophils"          = "#4169E1",
    "B cells"              = "#C9A2FF",
    "T cells"              = "#B44CFF",
    "NK cells"             = "#5B0E8A",
    "Neural/glial cells"   = "#FF7F00",
    "Schwann cells"        = "#FFA64D" 
)

VlnPlot(sc_combined_receptors_score, features = "signature_1sc_combined_receptors_score", group.by = "seurat_clusters", pt.size = 0) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_colours) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Receptors score", title = NULL) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "black")
```

```{r}
FeaturePlot(
  sc_combined_receptors_score, features = "signature_1sc_combined_receptors_score", reduction = "umap") +
  labs(color = "Receptors score") +
  theme(plot.title = element_blank())
```

# What receptor genes are upregulated in tumour-bearing Monocytes?

### Subset for Monocytes

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(sc_combined) <- "seurat_clusters"

sc_combined_monocytes <- subset(sc_combined, idents = "Monocytes")
```

### DEGs in tumour-bearing monocytes

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(sc_combined_monocytes) <- "orig.ident"

DEGs_sc_combined_monocytes <- FindMarkers(sc_combined_monocytes, ident.1 = c("Agca_snLLC_LLC", "Brown_scLLC_2w", "Brown_scLLC_2.5w", "Brown_scLLC_3.5w", "Kim_scB16F10_B16F10", "Pryce_scC26_C26", "Pryce_scKPP_KPP", "Zhang_snKIC_KIC"), ident.2 = c("Agca_snLLC_CTL", "Brown_scLLC_CTL", "Kim_scB16F10_CTL", "Pryce_scC26_CTL", "Pryce_scKPP_CTL", "Zhang_snKIC_CTL"), logfc.threshold = 0, min.pct = 0.10, verbose = FALSE)
```

### Subset DEGs for p_val_adj < 0.05, avg_log2FC > 0.2, included in common_receptors

```{r}
DEGs_sc_combined_monocytes <- subset(DEGs_sc_combined_monocytes, p_val_adj < 0.05 & avg_log2FC > 0.2)

DEGs_sc_combined_monocytes <- DEGs_sc_combined_monocytes[
    rownames(DEGs_sc_combined_monocytes) %in% common_receptors,
]

rownames(DEGs_sc_combined_monocytes)
```



# What receptor genes are upregulated in tumour-bearing macrophages?

### Subset for macrophages

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(sc_combined) <- "seurat_clusters"

sc_combined_macrophages <- subset(sc_combined, idents = "Macrophages")
```

### DEGs in tumour-bearing macrophages

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(sc_combined_macrophages) <- "orig.ident"

DEGs_sc_combined_macrophages <- FindMarkers(sc_combined_macrophages, ident.1 = c("Agca_snLLC_LLC", "Brown_scLLC_2w", "Brown_scLLC_2.5w", "Brown_scLLC_3.5w", "Kim_scB16F10_B16F10", "Pryce_scC26_C26", "Pryce_scKPP_KPP", "Zhang_snKIC_KIC"), ident.2 = c("Agca_snLLC_CTL", "Brown_scLLC_CTL", "Kim_scB16F10_CTL", "Pryce_scC26_CTL", "Pryce_scKPP_CTL", "Zhang_snKIC_CTL"), logfc.threshold = 0, min.pct = 0.10, verbose = FALSE)
```

### Subset DEGs for p_val_adj < 0.05, avg_log2FC > 0.2, included in the sc_combined receptors

```{r}
DEGs_sc_combined_macrophages_from_tumour <- subset(DEGs_sc_combined_macrophages, p_val_adj < 0.05 & avg_log2FC > 0.2)

DEGs_sc_combined_macrophages_from_tumour <- DEGs_sc_combined_macrophages_from_tumour[
    rownames(DEGs_sc_combined_macrophages_from_tumour) %in% common_receptors,
]

rownames(DEGs_sc_combined_macrophages_from_tumour)
```



# Common receptors upregulated in cachectic monocytes and macrophages

```{r}
DEGs_mono_macro <- unique(c(rownames(DEGs_sc_combined_monocytes),
                     rownames(DEGs_sc_combined_macrophages_from_tumour)))

DEGs_mono_macro
```


## Mean expression values of DEGs in monocytes (to manually make heatmap)

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Subset monocytes
Idents(sc_combined) <- "seurat_clusters"
monocytes <- subset(sc_combined, idents = "Monocytes")

# Make sure 'condition' exists
ctl_samples <- c(
  "Agca_snLLC_CTL",
  "Brown_scLLC_CTL",
  "Kim_scB16F10_CTL",
  "Pryce_scC26_CTL",
  "Pryce_scKPP_CTL",
  "Zhang_snKIC_CTL"
)

monocytes$condition <- ifelse(monocytes$orig.ident %in% ctl_samples,
                              "CTL",
                              "Tumour")

# Set condition as identity
Idents(monocytes) <- "condition"

# Set default assay
DefaultAssay(monocytes) <- "RNA"

# Keep only genes present in monocytes
genes_mono <- intersect(DEGs_mono_macro, rownames(monocytes))

# Compute mean expression per condition
avg_expr_monocytes <- AverageExpression(
  monocytes,
  features = genes_mono,
  group.by = "condition",
  return.seurat = FALSE
)$RNA

# View the result
avg_expr_monocytes
```


## Mean expression values of DEGs in monocytes (to manually make heatmap)

```{r}
# Subset macrophages
Idents(sc_combined) <- "seurat_clusters"
macrophages <- subset(sc_combined, idents = "Macrophages")


# Make sure 'condition' exists
ctl_samples <- c(
  "Agca_snLLC_CTL",
  "Brown_scLLC_CTL",
  "Kim_scB16F10_CTL",
  "Pryce_scC26_CTL",
  "Pryce_scKPP_CTL",
  "Zhang_snKIC_CTL"
)

macrophages$condition <- ifelse(macrophages$orig.ident %in% ctl_samples,
                                "CTL",
                                "Tumour")

# Set condition as identity
Idents(macrophages) <- "condition"

DefaultAssay(macrophages) <- "RNA"

# Keep only genes present in macrophages
genes_macro <- intersect(DEGs_mono_macro, rownames(macrophages))

# Compute mean expression per condition
avg_expr_macrophages <- AverageExpression(
  macrophages,
  features = genes_macro,
  group.by = "condition",
  return.seurat = FALSE
)$RNA

# View the result
avg_expr_macrophages
```
